note: Recorded requirements for module GRV (hand-authored, see README).

requirements.title: Online grievance registration
requirements.description: The system shall allow an applicant to register a grievance online against an application, with category and description, and shall route it quickly to the District Social Welfare Officer of the applicant's district.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a grievance registered against an application, when it is saved, then a grievance number is shown and it appears in the DSWO's grievance list.

requirements.title: Grievance disposal
requirements.description: The system shall allow the District Social Welfare Officer to record the action taken and close a grievance, and send an SMS to the applicant with the action taken.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an action taken report of at least 50 characters, when the DSWO closes the grievance, then the applicant receives an SMS with the action taken.

requirements.title: Appeal against rejection
requirements.description: The system shall allow an applicant to file an appeal to the Director, Social Welfare within 30 days of rejection, and the Director shall decide it within 15 working days.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a rejection on 1 October, when the applicant files an appeal on 25 October, then the appeal is registered and assigned to the Director.
Given 31 days since rejection, when an appeal is attempted, then it is refused.
